changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.05[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]TorBox: faster cache check[/COLOR]
-Hashes are checked in groups of 100, all at the same time, as TorBox recommends. A busy search used to send them all in one request, which was slow and could miss cached sources.
-Cache results are kept for 30 minutes, so searching the same title again is instant.
-Sources whose hash comes in capitals or in base32, such as some from PirateBay and Knaben, play again. They showed as cached but were dropped when you picked them.
[COLOR fffdb515]TorBox: quicker playback[/COLOR]
-Picking a source takes one request less: the extra cache check before adding the torrent is gone, because TorBox already refuses anything that is not cached.
-Waits only happen when TorBox asks to slow down. Any other error no longer costs about 9 seconds per source in autoplay.
-The file list of a torrent you just added is always read fresh, with one more try if it is not ready yet.
-A torrent with no playable file is removed from your TorBox account instead of staying there.
-Next episode in autoplay no longer waits 2 seconds before it starts resolving.
[COLOR fffdb515]TorBox: episodes and season packs[/COLOR]
-Season packs that do not contain the episode you asked for are left out of the source list, instead of failing when you play them.
[COLOR fffdb515]TorBox: Usenet[/COLOR]
-Usenet items resolve with fresh data and wait 10 seconds at most instead of 22.
-Use Usenet Services (NZB) stays off when you turn it off. It used to switch itself back on at every search.
